graph: one tflite, no graph input/output between layers
weights_note: fixture layer 0 repeated for all 2 layers (ticket 05 allows weight reuse): this graph is NOT a real 24-layer Qwen2.5-0.5B stack
tolerance_rationale: Code level on a 24-layer CHAIN is not the single-layer contract. Registered before the first board run: int8_tol=1200 codes, derived as sqrt(24) x the per-layer device-vs-golden max of the same tier (ticket 04f measured 247 codes on one layer at 8W16A native; sqrt(24)*247 = 1210 -> 1200), i.e. the independent-rounding random-walk bound. It is a PROPAGATION bound, not a relaxation of the per-layer contract; the measured value is reported as-is and a miss is reported as FAIL.
rel_l2_rationale: Registered before the first board run: one layer's device-vs-golden rel_l2 at this tier is ~1e-2 (from ticket 04f abs(dcos) 4.6e-5); a 24-layer chain adds rounding per layer, so 5e-2 is the registered cap (sqrt(24)*1e-2 = 4.9e-2).

quality_criterion.source: ADR 0005 sixth revision: int8 weights -> quality EXPECTATION 0.9998; 24 chained layers accumulate, so a miss is reported, not smoothed. The real quality gate is the logits (ticket 06).
quality_criterion.code_criterion: device vs quantised golden: |delta| <= int8_tol codes
